title: Window Shades and Visibility Safety Concerns
summary: This topic mainly centers on complaints that window shades or related controls create safety concerns by obstructing visibility or allowing rear passengers to interfere, alongside one favorable comment about the shades' adjustable design.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the window shades for being enjoyable and able to slide upward.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the vehicle or its features as dangerous, citing obstructed visibility, rear-passenger control of shades and seat massage, and one separate complaint about waiting for the engine to fire at intersections.

limitations: One negative example concerns waiting for the engine to fire at busy intersections rather than window shades, so the topic cluster includes at least one loosely related safety complaint.
